events.n: residency in the Baltic Sea at the invitation of the Tara Ocean Foundation; embarked in Stockholm (Sweden); "Sea samples" series
events.q: In July 2023, invited by the Tara Ocean Foundation, Yann Bagot embarked in Stockholm (Sweden), aboard the schooner Tara, for a residency in the Baltic Sea, as part of the Tara Europa scientific expedition.

events.n: residency on the island of Skaftö, invited by the EMBRC (European Marine Biological Resource Centre)
events.q: This experience at sea is extended by a residency period at the Kristineberg oceanographic station, on the island of Skaftö in Sweden, invited by the EMBRC (European Marine Biological Resource Centre) as part of the BiOcean 5D program
